notes.title: BUGS FIXED - V1.1
notes.content:
[i][b]We've been doing some maintenance on your SUB and found lots of broken buttons and stuff like that. Our really impressive engineers have fixed you up, ready to head back into the salty blue water of the sea! Also, keep an eye out on that shopkeeper guy. He looks super sketchy...[/b][/i]


[b]Version 1.1 Changelog[/b]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced difficulty in all modes
[*] Getting struck by lightning now boosts you slightly upwards
[*] Ammo no longer spawns when you’re out of the screen area
[*] The lazer weapon now shoots slightly faster
[*] Increased the price of the lazer upgrade from 100 to 140
[*] Sharks and support heli’s now get carried up inside tornadoes 
[*] You now get 1 scrap for killing the shopkeeper
[*] Increased the price of pet sharks from 30 to 40
[*] Slightly decreased the health of pet sharks
[*] You can now shoot enemy torpedoes
[*] Sharks now eat Noah
[*] The screen freezes for slightly longer after being hit
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Octo boss attacks not hurting the player at times
[*] Fixed some text not showing correctly
[*] Mines explode when entering the shop
[*] Fixed a crash where you’d kill the shopkeeper with the Fork Sub
[*] Fixed the BOSS’D achievement
[*] Fixed the combo multiplier still depleting when the game is paused
[*] Changed the FLIGHT achievement image
[*] Fork Sub now stabs your support heli
[*] Fixed player hit effect happening when stating a run or buying HP
[/list]

[b][i]Coming soon: creatures from the deep and a stronger octo...[/i][/b]

notes.title: LEADERBOARDS UPDATE - V1.05
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35176543/40e79211d02f6263350ebd39896d5b7c80c6cfa9.png[/img]

[b][i]Due to unauthorized experimentation around the lab, your assigned SUB was fitted out with a top of the line yet unnecessary receiving and uploading system. You can now track your abilities online across the entire world with Steam leaderboards! How brilliant![/i][/b]

[b]Version 1.05 Changelog[/b]

[b]New stuff[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam Leaderboards*
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The shield upgrade now protects against boss attacks
[*] Options now automatically save 
[*] Better and more efficient storing of score data (due to this, highscores have been erased, although progress is still saved)
[*] Limited the maximum amount of explosion particles
[*] Elite bosses are now more common at higher difficulties
[*] Slightly lowered chances of a tornado
[*] Slightly reduce hard mode difficulty 
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some upgrade prices being incorrect
[*] Fixed some objects and boss’ not pausing correctly
[*] The mine upgrade no longer spawns mines when the game is paused
[*] Spelling fixes (go me)
[*] A few bugs fixed with the tornado
[/list]

[i]Next update: Something from the deep…[/i]

[i]*If you experience any problems with uploading or viewing highscores/leaderboards, please leave a comment below! Thanks lots :)[/i]
